required.check: manifest, tokens, motion, components, and acceptance versions match
color, type, surface, grid, and motion tokens match and are consumed by implementation variables
all content trace kinds use the manifest enum
runtime emits unseen, entered, active, and complete states
a case flow contains 4 to 6 trace nodes
a case flow contains an unknown boundary node
each flow has one artifact node linked to its public evidence record
repair-statement, workflow-system, and source-image are closed schema variants
reconstructed or placeholder evidence is labeled on the visible surface
the server passes explicit public content fields and never the evidence registry
every route has exactly one h1
interactive controls have a visible focus state
interactive targets are at least 44px in their compact breakpoint
prefers-reduced-motion exposes content and removes transforms
server-rendered content is visible before the motion-ready class exists
evidence follows its claim in DOM order and no CSS visual reordering is used
no parallax, custom cursor, autoplay, ambient loop, scroll hijack, or transition all

manualAudit: One dominant visual event per viewport
Source drawer works by keyboard and returns focus
Mobile artifact annotations become an ordered legend
Semantic colors are paired with labels
No private or proprietary material is exposed
